name: Tenens propositi
gloss: the one holding, of the objective
wiring_note: Named in advance under the binomial law for census item C-53, working_objective.set, so that a name with no animal behind it stays visible instead of becoming a quiet omission. It should carry a stated objective into a later call that did not restate it. The seat above is the nearest available approximation, not the part: C-53 has no implementation anywhere in the runtime, and the catalogue has no key for it. The world is a placement rather than a measurement. The item is filed at L2 in the linear hierarchy because setting an objective is local work on what you send, while the behaviour it claims, an objective surviving into a call that did not contain it, is the REMEMBER class. Nothing has been run that could decide it.

fuel.law: IV. No fuel, because nothing has been called. A composition with no fuel is a name rather than an organism.

receipt.claim: would carry a stated objective into a call that did not restate it
receipt.why_it_matters: C-53, C-54 and C-55 are OPEN and they do not exist: grep for working_objective across the runtime returns one hit, inside an experiment's own docstring. They are absent rather than compressed. Chapter III's sealed prediction 4 concerned append without consolidate and could not be run for the same reason. An entry that says UNMEASURED here is the honest state; the failure mode this file prevents is a receipt written from the expectation table.
